resources.string: A single-lead reading from your strap\'s clasp
The strap ended the reading as invalid
Sit still, rest your arm, then tap Start and hold the clasp contacts with thumb and finger of your other hand.
Hold the clasp contacts firmly with thumb and finger of your other hand.
Keep still — the strap usually needs 6 to 10 seconds of steady contact before the reading starts (%1$d s so far).
Keep holding still until it reaches 100 percent. If contact slips, the strap starts over.
The reading is saved and the session on the strap is closed.
Usually contact was lost. The session is closed; you can start again.
The strap did not accept the start: it needs a connected WHOOP MG with the full encrypted link.
Only the WHOOP MG has ECG contacts.
